params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.enable_secure_boot
params.description: Defines whether the instance has Secure Boot enabled. Secure Boot helps ensure that the system only runs authentic software by verifying the digital signature of all boot components, and halting the boot process if signature verification fails.

params.name: data.enable_integrity_monitoring
params.description: Defines whether the instance has integrity monitoring enabled. Enables monitoring and attestation of the boot integrity of the instance. The attestation is performed against the integrity policy baseline. This baseline is initially derived from the implicitly trusted boot image when the instance is created.

methods.name: getEnableSecureBoot
methods.description: Defines whether the instance has Secure Boot enabled.

methods.name: setEnableSecureBoot
methods.description: Defines whether the instance has Secure Boot enabled.

methods.name: getEnableIntegrityMonitoring
methods.description: Defines whether the instance has integrity monitoring enabled.

methods.name: setEnableIntegrityMonitoring
methods.description: Defines whether the instance has integrity monitoring enabled.
